meta.name: HTTPS Proxy
meta.shortDescription: Local HTTPS reverse proxy for other pups (self-signed TLS + web admin)
meta.longDescription: Generates **one self-signed TLS certificate** per config (default SAN **dogebox**; ports are not part of certs — the same cert works for `https://dogebox:8080`, `https://dogebox:10000`, etc.). Use **port listeners** in the web UI so each HTTPS port forwards to that pup’s HTTP URL (e.g. `8080` → `http://127.0.0.1:8080`). If you leave port listeners empty, a single **PUBLIC_PORT** uses host-based routes instead. Admin is at `/__proxy/` on every listener. Trust `cert.pem` from the admin API. This is **not** Let’s Encrypt.

sections.name: HTTP/TLS
sections.description: When no port listeners are configured in the UI, HTTPS binds to this port on 0.0.0.0. If you add port listeners, each row uses its own HTTPS port (PUBLIC_PORT is ignored).

sections.name: Storage & admin
sections.description: Config and TLS material persist under HTTPS_PROXY_STORAGE. Set a fixed admin token to skip the generated admin.token file.

fields.name: HTTPS_PROXY_ADMIN_TOKEN
fields.label: Admin API token (optional; empty = auto-generated file)
